snippet.title: Make Time For Memories - See The Results In Your Business
snippet.description:
As entrepreneurs, we can get busy. And I don't mean busy, I mean REALLY busy! 20 hours a day busy. Weekends busy!

With the sudden death of Dad 2 years ago today, my world was rocked. I realised that things can change on a dime and working hard to enjoy something in the future no longer makes sense!

Since then over the last 2 years I've made a massive effort to value family time and me time, and I've put specific times on work time. This has allowed us to grow closer as a family, me to get healthier, and friendships to blossom outside of the work space.
